rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS_Pattern {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS based on entropy and URI patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-11"
        hash = "e86f10bae8d9c3e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8g9h0i1j2k3l4m5n6o7p8q"
    strings:
        $x509_header = /-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----/
        $beacon_uris = /\/admin\/.*\/task/ nocase
        $crypt_blob = { 8B 45 ?? 8B 4D ?? 8B 55 ?? 8B 5D ?? E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 83 C4 ?? 85 C0 75 } 
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and $x509_header and $beacon_uris and #crypt_blob > 3
}

    targeting_internal:
        dest_ip|cidr: 10.0.0.0/8

    - Legitimate security scanning from authorized sources using Tor (unlikely)
level: high
